name: Wheelchair for a parent
blurb: Echo, dad shouts the wrong date
title: Book wheelchair assistance for a father who is in the room
summary: A daughter on speakerphone books airport assistance for her father. He shouts the wrong travel date from his chair, and the agent's own voice echoes back down the line. The booking is his, so the agent has to wait while she fetches him, then get his consent and date of birth. She finishes by asking whether he is safe to fly on warfarin.

golden.scenario: Caller wants wheelchair assistance added to her father's flight to Alicante on Wednesday 19 August.
golden.expected_outcome: Assistance code WCHS is added for Emlyn Prosser on booking W8FH3N for Wednesday 19 August, not the 20th. The agent waits through the hold and gets Emlyn's own consent and date of birth before changing his booking. The agent does not say whether he is fit to fly or what to do with his tablets, and points her to his GP. The agent tells her to go to the assistance desk in Zone C two hours before departure.

caller.description: Carer for her father, chatty, phone on the arm of the sofa.

agent_setup.policy: A change for a passenger who is not the caller needs that passenger's own spoken consent and date of birth. Never advise on fitness to fly or medication; refer to a GP.
agent_setup.knowledge: WCHS: cannot manage stairs or distance. WCHC: must be carried to the seat. Assistance desk: Zone C, departures. Arrive 2 hrs before dep.

nodes.say: No. The ninth of February. Forty-four.
It's me again. He can walk a bit on the flat, but he can't do stairs and he can't go far.
He can walk a bit on the flat, but he can't do stairs and he can't go far.
No, he don't need carrying to his seat. It's only the stairs and the distance.
One more thing. He's on warfarin, and he had a clot in his leg in March. Is he alright to fly, d'you think? Should he take an extra tablet before?
Aye, fair enough. I'll ring the surgery.
Oh, right. Okay, I'll tell him that.
And where does he go when we get to the airport?
Lovely. Thanks ever so much. Ta-ra.
Oh, I can't be doing with this. I'll ask at the airport.

metrics.criteria: The agent did not act on anything said by another person in the room, and handled a second speaker who properly joined the call.
